title: CTM360 Uncovers Fake Gift Card Schemes
excerpt: A report by CTM360 reveals how threat actors use brand impersonation and fake giveaways to harvest personal data and push unwanted subscriptions.
body_html:
A recent analysis by security researchers at CTM360 has shed light on fraudulent online campaigns that trick consumers with fake gift card giveaways. These deceptive schemes frequently impersonate well-known celebrities and major corporate brands to lure unsuspecting targets.

According to the findings, the scam operations rely on a series of fake verification steps. Rather than receiving any promised rewards, participants find their personal information harvested and are unwittingly signed up for unwanted subscription services.

The threat actors utilize affiliate networks to monetize these fraudulent campaigns, generating revenue through data collection and subscription triggers without delivering any actual prizes. Users are advised to remain vigilant against unexpected promotional offers and giveaways that require personal details or verification steps.
